say:2:1423114002:0.text: It's obvious, isn't it? What good is it to stay here?
say:2:1423114002:0.source_cn: 当然了，不走还待在这里干什么？

say:3:1423114003:1.text: Instead of waiting for the Lightbearers to split us up and send us to some far-flung places, I'd rather we all go to a new place and start fresh!
say:3:1423114003:1.source_cn: 比起村子被耀光彻底抛弃，伙计们被打散送到不知名的矿山，...

say:4:1423114004:1.text: I already told you, if we work with Sal'thorin and enchant the celestrites, we could create something even better than echorites.
say:4:1423114004:1.source_cn: 我已经跟你说过，如果能与萨洛克兰合作，研究将魔力注入矿...

say:5:1423114005:1.text: It's the best way to save our village, and yet here you are, sending our craftsmen away!
say:5:1423114005:1.source_cn: 这才是拯救村子最好的方式，可你不仅无动于衷，现在还要让...

say:6:1423114006:1.text: Listen to yourself! You're no different from Eldric!
say:6:1423114006:1.source_cn: 你说的这些话跟弗林之前的话术有什么差别？

say:7:1423114007:1.text: He talked us into working with those underground pointy ears, but what happened in the end? The echorites turned out to be dragon eggshells, and they were gone just like that!
say:7:1423114007:1.source_cn: 什么跟地底合作才能得到最好的矿石，让我们矮人出人出力帮...

say:8:1423114008:1.text: Had it not been for him, our village wouldn't be in this sorry state!
say:8:1423114008:1.source_cn: 如果不是他联合地底的尖耳朵搞这些阴谋诡计，深岩村根本不...

say:9:1423114009:1.text: But our village wouldn't have prospered either without echorites.
say:9:1423114009:1.source_cn: 没有深岩晶，深岩村也不会有之前的繁荣。

say:10:1423114010:1.text: Are you defending Eldric? I knew it! You two are in cahoots!
say:10:1423114010:1.source_cn: 什么意思？你在帮弗林说话？你们果然是一伙的！

say:11:1423114011:1.text: I'm just stating the facts. We owe our previous success to both the echorites and the production line we set up.
say:11:1423114011:1.source_cn: 我只是在陈述事实，深岩村的繁荣离不开深岩晶，也离不开我...

say:12:1423114012:1.text: Are you seriously going to throw away all our hard work and start over?
say:12:1423114012:1.source_cn: 你真的要彻底舍弃这些心血，从头开始吗？

say:13:1423114013:1.text: In any case, I can no longer trust those pointy ears.
say:13:1423114013:1.source_cn: 总之，我不可能再信任那些地底的尖耳朵和合作这种话术了。

choice_prompt:14:1423114013.text: In any case, I can no longer trust those pointy ears.
choice_prompt:14:1423114013.source_cn: 总之，我不可能再信任那些地底的尖耳朵和合作这种话术了。

say:16:1423114015:1.text: Yeah! There's no way <style="stress"><player_name></style> could be on Eldric's side, right?
say:16:1423114015:1.male: Yeah! There's no way <style="stress"><player_name></style> could be on Eldric's side, right?
say:16:1423114015:1.female: Yeah! There's no way <style="stress"><player_name></style> could be on Eldric's side, right?

say:17:1423114016:1.text: After all, he was the one who exposed Eldric's plan.
say:17:1423114016:1.male: After all, he was the one who exposed Eldric's plan.
say:17:1423114016:1.female: After all, she was the one who exposed Eldric's plan.

say:18:1423114017:1.text: Let him show you the potential of the arcane steel research, and then you can decide afterward. How does that sound?
say:18:1423114017:1.male: Let him show you the potential of the arcane steel research, and then you can decide afterward. How does that sound?
say:18:1423114017:1.female: Let her show you the potential of the arcane steel research, and then you can decide afterward. How does that sound?

say:19:1423114018:1.text: This incredible technology could help us produce something even better than echorites!
say:19:1423114018:1.source_cn: 你还没机会见识吧，有可能研制出超越深岩晶的矿石的伟大技术！

say:20:1423114019:1.text: Um... I have to think about it.

say:21:1423114020:1.text: Alright, I'll take a look at this so-called technology, just to see if you're trying to bluff us.
say:21:1423114020:1.source_cn: 为了判断你们说的究竟是不是谎话，我可以跟你们去看看那所...

say:22:1423114021:1.text: Well, can your scouts wait for a bit before they go?
say:22:1423114021:1.source_cn: 那你的先遣队成员们，不用着急动身了吧？

say:28:1423114024:1.text: Only if what you show me is enough to change my mind.
say:28:1423114024:1.source_cn: 前提是你们让我看到的东西真的能让我回心转意。

say:29:1423114025:1.text: Let's pick a date. We'll need some time to prepare.
say:29:1423114025:1.source_cn: 那我们约个时间吧。我们还得……准备准备。

say:30:1423114026:1.text: I'll say this upfront—if I don't see something convincing soon, I won't be able to stop these youngsters from leaving.
say:30:1423114026:1.source_cn: 如果不能尽快见到能说服我的技术，我可拦不住这些年轻人。
